name: Divider
description: Separates content with a muted rule: horizontal, vertical or with a label in the middle. Prefer spacing; add a divider only when groups blur together. Replaces Livewire's separator.

livewire.name: divider
capabilities: The default slot is the label

vue.name: Divider
capabilities: The default slot is the label

props.name: orientation
props.description: A rule across the inline axis, or a vertical one between items in a row, such as a toolbar. Emitted as data-orientation.

props.name: label
props.description: Text in the middle of the rule, such as or continue with.

props.name: align
props.description: Where a label sits along the rule. Emitted as data-align.

props.name: strength
props.description: Subtle uses the muted border, strong the default border. Emitted as data-strength.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides the divider from assistive technology, for rules that only decorate. Emitted as data-decorative.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { label: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: An hr for a plain horizontal rule; a div with role separator and aria-orientation for a vertical or labelled one, labelled by its label.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The label, with a rule on each side.

requirements: role=separator (an hr's own role), with aria-orientation on a vertical one.
A labelled divider is named by its label (aria-labelledby), since a separator's children are presentational.
A decorative divider is aria-hidden (role none on an hr).
The rule meets 3:1 against its surface only with strength strong; subtle rules are decorative contrast, like edges.
